en.headline: Lee orders acceleration of building maintenance reforms after Wang Fuk Court fire
en.dek: The Chief Executive told officials on Monday to submit amendments to six ordinances as soon as possible following a progress briefing on the independent committee’s recommendations.
body: Chief Executive John Lee chaired a meeting on Monday to receive briefings on the government’s progress in implementing systemic reforms and taking forward recommendations from the independent committee on the Wang Fuk Court fire that killed 168 people.

Lee instructed all bureaux and departments to accelerate the reforms and to submit amendments to six pieces of legislation to the Legislative Council as soon as possible. The Fire Services Ordinance amendment bill is set for first and second reading next month, while Buildings Ordinance changes will go to the Panel on Development on 24 November with a target of submitting the bill early next year.

Amendments to the Competition Ordinance, the Organized and Serious Crimes Ordinance and the Independent Commission Against Corruption Ordinance are planned for early next year to combat bid-rigging. A joint task force has arrested 163 people in two operations involving more than HK$230 million, according to officials.

Lee said the reforms must be implemented rigorously and in full. “We must all learn from the lesson, and earnestly implement reform measures to prevent such tragedies from recurring, and continue to provide full support to the affected residents to help them begin their new lives as soon as possible,” he said in a statement.

zh.headline: 李家超下令加快樓宇維修制度改革 防止宏福苑悲劇重演
zh.dek: 行政長官周一聽取進度匯報後，指示各部門盡快向立法會提交六項法例修訂，全力落實獨立委員會建議。
body: 行政長官李家超周一主持會議，聽取官員就落實宏福苑火災後系統性改革及推進獨立委員會建議的進度匯報。該場火災造成168人死亡。
李家超指示各政策局及部門加快改革步伐，盡快將六項法例的修訂草案提交立法會。消防條例修訂草案將於下月進行首讀及二讀，建築物條例修訂則於11月24日提交發展事務委員會，目標明年年初提交草案。
競爭條例、有組織及嚴重罪行條例及廉政公署條例的修訂計劃於明年年初提交，以打擊圍標行為。官員表示，聯合特遣隊在兩次行動中已拘捕163人，涉案金額超過2.3億元。
李家超表示，改革必須嚴格及全面落實。他在聲明中說：「我們必須汲取教訓，切實推行改革措施，防止悲劇重演，並繼續全力支援受影響居民，助他們盡快開展新生活。」
